findings.evidence: CartanMap.lean:198 `noncomputable abbrev finiteModulesExactStructure`; CartanMap.lean:221 `theorem finiteModulesExactStructure_conflation_iff` (was `@[simp] theorem` per the diff); SimpleBasis.lean:272-273 vs Matrix.lean:52-53 for the two basis types. The PR description still describes the superseded mechanism ("in-proof equality ... proved with `ExactStructure.ext`, because the former's body is not exposed") and claims "No existing file changes", so nothing in the PR records the reason for the new approach.
findings.fix: Document the reducibility at the definition (a comment stating that the two spellings must stay definitionally interchangeable and that downstream bases depend on it), or keep it a `def` and supply an explicit conversion/equality lemma used at the call sites; either way justify the `@[simp]` removal on `finiteModulesExactStructure_conflation_iff` rather than dropping it silently.
findings.issue: `finiteModulesExactStructure` is changed from `noncomputable def` to `noncomputable abbrev` with no comment or docstring change explaining why. The new statements rely on the resulting reducible defeq: `simpleClassBasis` has type `Module.Basis I ℤ (ExactK0 (finiteModulesExactStructure A))` (SimpleBasis.lean:272-273) but is passed where `extEulerMatrix` expects `Module.Basis I ℤ (ExactK0 ((ExactStructure.abelian C).fullSubcategory P hP))` (Matrix.lean:52-53), so a reader of `transpose_cartanMatrix_mul_extEulerMatrix_eq_diagonal` cannot see why the bases match. The same change forces dropping `@[simp]` from `finiteModulesExactStructure_conflation_iff` (line 221), weakening automation for every downstream user of that lemma.

findings.evidence: No occurrence of `hPi` after line 124 in the proof body (lines 125-143): `hentry` mentions only `(P i)` and `(S j)`, and the closing `rw` uses `(P i).property`.
findings.issue: `hPi : ModuleCat.isFG A (P i).obj` is introduced but never used; the proof instead goes through `cartanMap_of A (P i).property` at line 136. It is a plain Prop, not a class, so it cannot be picked up by instance search either.

summary: The PR makes the pre-existing `finiteModulesExactStructure` reducible (`def` → `abbrev`) so the new statements' bases typecheck across two spellings of the same exact structure, undocumented and with a silent `@[simp]` removal as collateral; plus one unused `have` in the main proof.
